alex.ae: FYI we kicked off a Helios Health POC. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC, multi-domain proofing, and a clear pricing ask for Dedicated vs Private. Can someone own the tech answers?

sam-sales: Putting @maria-se and @leo-sec on this. Customer expects HIPAA-adjacent controls and wants a 4-week POC with prod-like ingress. They asked: pricing for a small dedicated pool, SCIM bulk sync behavior, SAML multiple-Audience/domains, deprovision timing, and whether we can sign a data residency addendum.

maria-se: I can take the POC coordination. Quick bullets: SCIM -> supports full + incremental (delta) syncs, SCIM endpoint is "https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/<tenant>" and we recommend initial full sync then 15-min deltas for orgs >5k users. Rate limits: default 600 reqs/min, we can bump for Dedicated POC.

maria-se: SAML -> we support uploading IdP metadata and multiple AssertionConsumerService URLs; you can bind multiple domains by adding multiple <Audience> entries in the SP config. Attribute mapping: we map 'eduPersonPrincipalName' or 'email' -> username, 'groups' -> roles. Sample mapping snippet: ```saml-attr-map: {"email":"user.email","groups":"user.roles"}```

ian-eng: Quick note on deprovisioning: we follow SCIM delete semantics. For soft deletes we mark accounts as suspended for 30 days by default (configurable). For immediate hard delete we need a signed request and legal ok — ops will log to audit.

maria-se: For RBAC: we support role templates + custom roles. You can map incoming SCIM group names to role templates during the POC. We can demo canary role rollout (gradual assignment) so Helios can validate least-privilege flows.

leo-sec: Security checklist items: SOC2 Type II report available, ISO27001 in progress, we support KMS integration for Private and Dedicated via customer-managed keys, and we can provide VPN or VPC peering for Private deployments. For the security questionnaire: please send the PDF, we'll fill standard answers and flag any custom legal asks.

sam-sales: They also asked about domain controls: they want domain proofing and tenant locking so subdomains can't be claimed by other orgs. Is that supported?

maria-se: Yes — Domain verification via DNS TXT is supported. We also have tenant-level domain allowlist and a tenant lock option (prevents new domains from being added without admin approval). We can demo tenant proofing in the POC.

ian-eng: A couple of blockers to call out: if they want per-token auditing at sub-second resolution we may need high-retention observability add-on; SCIM delta retention is 30 days by default. Also SCIM deprovisioning across services (embeddings storage) requires a wipe flow for Private deployments.

leo-sec: Legal/compliance: for HIPAA-like controls they should opt for Private or Dedicated with data residency and CME contract addendum. We typically require a minimum 3mo trial for full Private compliance review; Dedicated POC can be faster.

maria-se: Pricing roughs for discussion: Hosted POC - usage-based (small). Dedicated POC - ~$12k/mo baseline (1 GPU pool) with burst options; Private - depends on infra footprint, starts ~80k one-time + monthly support. I will pull exact numbers from pricing ops and post.

deploy-bot: <https://docs.redwood.example.com/scim|SCIM docs> · <https://docs.redwood.example.com/saml|SAML docs> · <https://console.redwood.example.com/presales-templates|Presales POC checklist>

alex.ae: Awesome, thanks everyone. @maria-se can you own the POC runbook and fill the questionnaire? @leo-sec can you review the answers and confirm KMS/VPC notes? I'll sync with the customer Wed EOD.

maria-se: On it. I'll draft a 4-week runbook: week1 scoping + domain proofing, week2 SCIM initial sync + SSO, week3 RBAC validation + audit checks, week4 cutover rehearsal + smoke tests. Will attach the runbook to the thread when ready.

leo-sec: I'll take the questionnaire after you draft it. Ping me for any non-standard encryption/legal asks. :thumbsup:

sam-sales: Thanks all — tagging the customer intro in the CRM and scheduling Wed call.

alex.ae: Closing loop: next update in this thread when runbook + pricing ops numbers are posted.
